parameters.name: AliyunCommodityCode
parameters.description:
The edition of the product. 

- If you do not specify this parameter, a Basic Edition product is created by default, which does not support the Thing Specification Language model.
- If you specify this parameter, only **iothub_senior** is supported, which indicates that a product that uses the Thing Specification Language model is created. In this case, you must also specify the **DataFormat** parameter.

<props="china">
><notice>
- Under an MQTT-type instance, the Thing Specification Language model is not supported. Do not specify this parameter.
- For Basic Edition products, the **Online Debug** and **Event Response** features are not supported in the IoT Platform console.

></notice></props>

<props="intl">
><notice>For Basic Edition products, the **Online Debug** feature is not supported in the IoT Platform console.
></notice></props>

parameters.name: AuthType
parameters.description:
The authentication method for devices under the product to connect to IoT Platform.

<props="china">
- **secret**: uses the device secret for device identity authentication. For more information, see [MQTT-TCP connection](~~73742~~).

- **id2**: uses IoT Device ID (ID²) for authentication.

    > Only the China (Shanghai) region supports ID²-based authentication. Products with the network connection type **NetType** set to **LORA** do not support ID²-based authentication. To use ID²-based authentication, you must purchase the ID² service.

   For more information, see [Use ID²-based authentication](~~141661~~).

- **one-party**: requires importing device authentication information (UserName, Password, SN) to IoT Platform, which authenticates devices based on the imported information.

    > Only under an MQTT-type instance can **AuthType** be set to **one-party**, and it must be set to **one-party**.


</props>


<props="china">If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is **secret**.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter. The default value is **secret**, which indicates that the device secret is used for device identity authentication. For more information, see [MQTT-TCP connection](~~73742~~).</props>

parameters.name: CategoryKey
parameters.description:
The identifier of the product category. If you specify this parameter, the created product uses the Thing Specification Language model of the specified category. If you do not specify this parameter, no standard Thing Specification Language model of any category is used.
Call [ListThingTemplates](~~150316~~) to view the predefined category information of IoT Platform and obtain the value of CategoryKey from the response.

parameters.name: DataFormat
parameters.description:
The data format. Valid values:

- **0**: pass-through/custom format (CUSTOM_FORMAT).
- **1**: Alink protocol (ALINK_FORMAT).

<props="china">
><notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, the data format for device communication is raw custom format, and **DataFormat** must be set to **0**.
></notice></props>

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the product. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: Id2
parameters.description:
<props="china">Specifies whether to enable ID²-based authentication. Valid values:</props>

<props="china">
- **true**: Enable ID²-based authentication.
- **false**: Do not enable ID²-based authentication.

</props>

<props="china">If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is **false**, which means ID²-based authentication is not enabled.</props>

<props="china">
> Only the China (Shanghai) region supports ID²-based authentication. If this parameter is set to **true** but the **AuthType** parameter is not set to **id2**, the system uses the value of the **AuthType** parameter.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JoinPermissionId
parameters.description:
<props="china">The LoRaWAN network credential ID. This parameter is required if the network connection type **NetType** is set to **LORA**.</props>

<props="china">Call [QueryLoRaJoinPermissions](~~109293~~) to query the **JoinPermissionId** of the LoRaWAN network credentials under your account.</props>

<props="china">If you do not have a LoRaWAN network credential, go to the [Link WAN console](https://linkwan.console.aliyun.com/join-permission-authorization) to create one.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>

parameters.name: NetType
parameters.description:
The network connection type.
Specify this parameter if the devices under the product are gateway devices or directly connected devices.

Valid values:

<props="china">- **LORA**: LoRaWAN.</props>
- **WIFI**: Wi-Fi.
- **CELLULAR**: cellular network.
- **ETHERNET**: Ethernet.
- **OTHER**: other.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is Wi-Fi.

<props="china">
><notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, **NetType** does not support the value **LORA**.
></notice></props>

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type of the product. Valid values:

- **0**: device. A device cannot attach sub-devices. It can connect to IoT Platform directly or as a sub-device of a gateway. When the device serves as a sub-device of a gateway, you must also specify **ProtocolType**.
- **1**: gateway. A gateway can attach sub-devices. It has a sub-device management module that maintains the topological relationships of sub-devices and synchronizes the topological relationships to IoT Platform.

<props="china">
><notice>Under an MQTT-type instance, the device must connect to IoT Platform as a directly connected device, and **NodeType** must be set to **0**.
></notice></props>

parameters.name: ProductName
parameters.description:
The name of the product to be created.
The product name must be 4 to 30 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

><notice> The product name must be unique within the current instance.
></notice>

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The protocol type used by the device to connect to the gateway.
Specify this parameter if the product uses the Thing Specification Language model (**AliyunCommodityCode**=**iothub_senior**) and the devices under the product need to connect to IoT Platform through a gateway.

Valid values:

- **modbus**: Modbus protocol.
- **opc-ua**: OPC UA protocol.
- **customize**: custom protocol.
- **ble**: BLE protocol.
- **zigbee**: ZigBee protocol.

parameters.name: PublishAuto
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically publish the Thing Specification Language model after the product is created.

- **true**: Publish.
- **false**: Do not publish.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is **true**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>
- Currently, IoT Platform supports resource group management only at the instance level. The request parameter **ResourceGroupId** is no longer effective and does not need to be specified.
- Resource groups previously set by calling this API remain effective.

></notice>

parameters.name: ValidateType
parameters.description:
The data validation level. If you do not specify this parameter, weak validation is used by default. Valid values:

- **1**: weak validation. Only the identifier and dataType fields of device data are validated. Other fields are not validated, and full data is forwarded.

 Data that passes validation is displayed on the **TSL Data** tab of the **Device Details** page in the IoT Platform console. Data that fails validation is not displayed.

 You can view data that fails validation through the **checkFailedData** parameter in forwarded data. For more information, see [Data formats](~~73736~~).

- **2**: no validation. Reported data is not validated, and full data is forwarded.

 Data is not displayed on the **TSL Data** tab of the **Device Details** page in the IoT Platform console.
